_comment: DCO Map Intelligence - baked area file (external tier). Copy to $profile:DCO_MapIntel.json on your server to feed the AI commander pre-computed key locations (villages, military sites, forests). Parallel arrays: index i across types/xs/zs/radii/weights describes one area. Produced offline (see docs/RECOM_DCO_MERGE_2026-06-09.md) or hand-authored. The native tier needs none of this; this file only adds offline-baked fidelity such as forests.
